overview:
Explore the breathtaking Himalayas with Safar Trails’ Ladakh Tour Package – 6 Nights / 7 Days. Discover Leh’s cultural landmarks, including Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, and Thiksey Monastery, before travelling to Nubra Valley via Khardung La.

Experience Diskit Monastery, Hunder’s sand dunes, Turtuk village, and the stunning blue waters of Pangong Lake. With planned transfers, hotel or camp stays, and meals as selected, this package offers a memorable Himalayan adventure.

Ideal for families, couples, and friends, your Ladakh journey can be planned around your preferred travel dates and requirements.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh – Acclimatisation
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh, where a Safar Trails representative will welcome you and arrange your transfer to the hotel. After check-in, spend the day resting and allowing your body to adjust to Ladakh’s high altitude. Avoid strenuous activities, stay hydrated according to your needs and follow appropriate medical guidance for high-altitude travel. The evening is free for rest and relaxation. Enjoy dinner at the hotel as per your selected meal plan.
itinerary.morningActivity: Arrival at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh, Safar Trails reception and hotel transfer
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in and mandatory rest to acclimatise to Ladakh's high altitude
itinerary.eveningActivity: Rest and relaxation at the hotel followed by dinner as per selected meal plan
itinerary.mealsIncluded: Dinner as per selected meal plan

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore Leh’s cultural and historical attractions. Visit Shanti Stupa for panoramic views, followed by Leh Palace and Namgyal Tsemo Monastery. Continue to the local market to explore shops and experience the atmosphere of Leh town. Later, visit Thiksey Monastery and Shey Palace, subject to opening hours and local access. Enjoy views of the Indus Valley before returning to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore Leh local market, followed by Thiksey Monastery and Shey Palace

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and begin your journey towards Nubra Valley via Khardung La, one of Ladakh’s famous high mountain passes. The route offers dramatic mountain scenery and panoramic views, subject to road and weather conditions. Continue to Nubra Valley and check in to your hotel or camp. Later, visit Diskit Monastery and admire the surrounding valley landscapes. Explore Hunder Village and its sand dunes. If available, you may opt for a double-humped Bactrian camel ride at an additional cost. Return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Leh
topPlacesToVisit.description: Leh is the starting and ending point of the tour and offers a combination of Himalayan scenery, historic landmarks, monasteries and local markets. Top places and experiences: Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Namgyal Tsemo Monastery, Leh Market, and Indus Valley views.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Nubra Valley
topPlacesToVisit.description: Nubra Valley is known for its striking mountain landscapes, wide-open scenery and the sand dunes around Hunder. It is one of the main highlights of a Ladakh sightseeing tour. Top places and experiences: Diskit Monastery, Hunder Village, Hunder Sand Dunes, optional double-humped Bactrian camel ride, and valley viewpoints and photography.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Khardung La
topPlacesToVisit.description: Khardung La is a well-known high mountain pass on the route towards Nubra Valley. The drive offers dramatic Himalayan scenery, but access depends on road conditions, weather and local restrictions. Top experiences: Scenic mountain drive, mountain photography at permitted stopping points, and panoramic views when visibility permits.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Turtuk Village
topPlacesToVisit.description: Turtuk is a picturesque village known for its distinctive local culture, traditional village setting and surrounding mountain landscapes. The visit is subject to the required permits and local access conditions. Top experiences: Village exploration, cultural and landscape photography, and local surroundings and traditional architecture, where accessible.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Pangong Lake
topPlacesToVisit.description: Pangong Lake is one of the most memorable stops on this itinerary. Its vast mountain setting and changing water colours make it a popular destination for photography and quiet scenic moments. Top experiences: Lakeside sightseeing, sunrise and sunset views (weather permitting), landscape photography, and overnight stay near the lake.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Thiksey Monastery and Shey Palace
topPlacesToVisit.description: Located in the Leh region, these attractions offer insight into Ladakh’s cultural and historic heritage. Their inclusion in the itinerary depends on opening hours and local access. Top experiences: Monastery architecture, heritage sightseeing, and views of the surrounding valley.

faqs.question: How many days are required for the Ladakh Tour Package?
faqs.answer: This Safar Trails itinerary covers 6 Nights / 7 Days, including Leh, Nubra Valley, Turtuk and Pangong Lake.

faqs.question: Where does the Ladakh tour begin and end?
faqs.answer: The tour begins with arrival at Leh Airport and ends with a departure transfer to Leh Airport.

faqs.question: What places are covered in this Ladakh itinerary?
faqs.answer: The itinerary includes Leh, Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Namgyal Tsemo Monastery, Thiksey Monastery, Shey Palace, Khardung La, Nubra Valley, Diskit Monastery, Hunder Sand Dunes, Turtuk Village and Pangong Lake.

faqs.question: Is acclimatisation included in the Ladakh tour package?
faqs.answer: Yes. Day 1 is reserved for rest and acclimatisation in Leh. This is important because Ladakh’s high altitude can cause altitude-related illness. Follow local health advisories and seek medical advice if you have concerns about high-altitude travel.

faqs.question: Is the Bactrian camel ride included in the package?
faqs.answer: The camel ride at Hunder is optional and subject to local availability. Confirm the applicable charges with Safar Trails before booking.

faqs.question: Can we visit Turtuk Village during this tour?
faqs.answer: Yes, Turtuk Village is included in the itinerary, subject to permit requirements, road conditions, weather and local access.

faqs.question: Is accommodation near Pangong Lake included?
faqs.answer: The itinerary includes an overnight stay near Pangong Lake. The exact camp or resort, facilities and room type should be confirmed in the booking quotation.

faqs.question: What is the best time to book a Ladakh holiday?
faqs.answer: The suitable travel period depends on road access, weather and the destinations you want to visit. Conditions can change quickly in high-altitude areas, so confirm the latest route accessibility and accommodation availability before booking.

faqs.question: Are permits and entry fees included?
faqs.answer: The supplied itinerary does not confirm whether permit fees, environmental charges or monument entry fees are included. Ask Safar Trails to list these items clearly in the final quotation.

faqs.question: Is the Ladakh Tour Package suitable for families and first-time visitors?
faqs.answer: It may suit travellers who are comfortable with long mountain journeys and high-altitude travel. First-time visitors should pay particular attention to acclimatisation and discuss any health concerns with a qualified medical professional before travelling.

faqs.question: What should I pack for a Ladakh trip?
faqs.answer: Pack clothing suitable for changing temperatures, warm layers, comfortable footwear, sun protection and personal essentials. Requirements vary by season, so check the forecast and seek advice for your selected travel dates.

faqs.question: How can I book the Ladakh Tour Package with Safar Trails?
faqs.answer: Share your travel dates, number of travellers, preferred accommodation and any special requirements with Safar Trails. Request a detailed quotation with confirmed inclusions, exclusions, permits and activity charges before confirming your booking.
